title: Parallel Layer Normalization for Universal Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2505.13142v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Layer Normalization (LN) is usually studied for its role in optimization, but it also acts as a multivariate nonlinearity between affine layers. We investigate how grouping LN units affects the approximation power of neural networks as width grows. In Parallel Layer Normalization networks (PLN-Nets), fixed-dimensional LN units are applied independently to groups between two affine layers. We prove that a shallow LN-Net with one LN unit is non-universal regardless of width, whereas PLN-Nets become universal as the number of parallel groups grows. The mechanism extends to deep networks, Root Mean Square Normalization (RMSNorm) variants, position-wise feed-forward networks, and convolutional networks under suitable grouping structures. translated_title: 用于万能逼近的并行层归一化
translated_abstract: 层归一化通常因其 在优化中的作用而被研究，但它同时也在仿射层之间充当一种多元非线性。我们研究了当网络宽度增长时，LN 单元的分组方式如何影响神经网络的逼近能力。在并行层归一化网络中，固定维度的 LN 单元被独立地应用于两个仿射层之间的各个组。我们证明，仅含一个 LN 单元的浅层 LN-Net 无论宽度多大都不具备万能逼近性，而 PLN-Nets 则随着并行组数量的增加变得具有万能逼近性。该机制在合适的分组结构下可扩展到深层网络、均方根归一化 变体、逐位置前馈网络以及卷积网络。受控的多层感知机 (MLP) 与物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 实验支持了 PLN 的实际可行性，而 CNN 和 ViT 实验表明组数会塑造有限样本拟合包络，但 d……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文证明仅含单个层归一化单元的浅层网络无论宽度多大都不具备万能逼近能力，而提出的并行层归一化网络（PLN-Nets）随着并行分组数量的增加即可实现万能逼近，且该机制还可推广到RMSNorm变体、逐位置前馈网络和卷积网络。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a shallow network with a single Layer Normalization unit is non-universal regardless of width, while the proposed Parallel Layer Normalization networks (PLN-Nets) achieve universal approximation as the number of parallel groups grows, a mechanism that further extends to RMSNorm variants, position-wise feed-forward networks, and convolutional networks.
